tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window / page background behind every card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: KPI cards, panels, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Table card-rows, inputs, secondary fills inside a panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and KPI values on bg, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, table body cells that are not the key column.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Uppercase labels, table headers, captions. Light theme is ~3.8:1 on surface-2: use only at 11px+ uppercase bold labels, never body copy (kept from the source).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline card edges and dividers. Tables have no grid lines.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Raffaello red: header bar, active tab, primary button, total rows, over-cap tags. In dark use it as a FILL only (text on black fails); text-on-red is always on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent-tinted total rows and red badges.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (header, primary button, OVER tag).

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Gold: brand bar in the logo, yellow buttons, WARN tag fill, hero-KPI label, chart second series.

tokens.name: yellow-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind pending / due rows.

tokens.name: yellow-ink
tokens.usage: Text on yellow-soft.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text on a yellow fill (WARN tag, yellow button).

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Approved, delivered, within PO; as text on good-soft or the surfaces.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: OK tag background.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: Hero KPI card fill (the one number that matters on a page, e.g. Certified to date).

tokens.name: hero-ink
tokens.usage: Value text on the hero KPI card.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Neutral grey: progress-bar track, inactive chart series, disabled controls.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between table card-rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row cell padding, gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutter between KPI cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding, gap between panels.
